fusions.name: Hushed Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Spoken Seal
fusions.desc: Speaks a word that shoves everything in a wide cone back 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and leaving it [Dimmed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Phrase
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Strike
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
